summary_en: East Japan Railway increased interim dividend to 44 yen per share from 42 yen, and raised year-end dividend forecast to 44 yen from 42 yen, bringing total annual dividend to 88 yen for FY2027. The increases reflect upward revision of full-year earnings guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding FY2027 Dividend Increase (Interim and Year-End Dividends) and Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
East Japan Railway announced increases in both interim and year-end dividends for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, reflecting improved operational performance. The company raised the interim dividend per share to 44 yen from 42 yen (ex-dividend date September 30, 2026), and revised the year-end dividend forecast upward to 44 yen from 42 yen, resulting in total annual dividend per share of 88 yen. This compares to 74 yen for the previous fiscal year.

The dividend increases are based on upward revisions to the full-year earnings guidance. The company now projects operating profit of 450 billion yen (up 21 billion yen or 4.9 percent from prior estimate), ordinary profit of 378 billion yen (up 25 billion yen or 7.1 percent), and net income attributable to parent company of 265 billion yen (up 10 billion yen or 3.9 percent). The improvement was driven primarily by increased railway transportation revenues.

Under its medium-term vision 'Yuusho 2034,' the company aims to raise the dividend payout ratio to 40 percent by fiscal 2027 as growth capital expenditures normalize, while implementing flexible share buyback programs as part of shareholder returns policy.
